evidence.field: Shang oracle glyph identity and source
evidence.text: Identifies this as a modern vector drawing of 車 in Shang oracle script style. The description cites a specific Hanziyuan image (J29288) and Academia Sinica image (43.F452); it does not represent a photograph of an inscribed artifact.
evidence.title: File:車-oracle.svg

evidence.field: Western Zhou bronze glyph identity and source
evidence.text: Identifies this as a modern vector drawing of 車 in Western Zhou bronze script style, citing Hanziyuan image B19579 and Academia Sinica image 34.E39B, associated on the page with 同卣 (mid-Western Zhou). The drawing is not an artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:車-bronze-5.svg

evidence.field: Shuowen seal glyph identity and source
evidence.text: Identifies a modern vector drawing of 車 in Shuowen seal script style, citing Hanziyuan image s10685; the page history also says a later version was taken from Academia Sinica. This is a script representation, not an ancient artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:車-seal.svg

evidence.text: The opened descriptions state that the vector representations are released under CC0/public-domain terms. The descriptions permit copying and reuse without requesting permission, to the extent allowed by law.
evidence.title: File:車-oracle.svg

evidence.field: exact original image URL for Shang oracle candidate
evidence.text: The page’s Original file link resolved to https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/15/%E8%BB%8A-oracle.svg. The web viewer could not render the SVG content type, but the direct URL was obtained from the actual page link, not guessed.

evidence.field: exact original image URL for Western Zhou bronze candidate
evidence.text: The page’s Original file link resolved to https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/25/%E8%BB%8A-bronze-5.svg. The direct fetch returned a cache miss in the web viewer; URL is copied from the page link and not inferred from a hash pattern.
evidence.title: File:車-bronze-5.svg

evidence.field: exact original image URL for Shuowen seal candidate
evidence.text: The page’s Original file link resolved to https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/a7/%E8%BB%8A-seal.svg. The web viewer could not render the SVG content type; the direct URL was taken from the linked file page.
evidence.title: File:車-seal.svg

search_audit.outcome: Search returned all three candidate Commons descriptions. Opened each page and checked described script style, source notes, and licensing.

search_audit.query: Wikimedia Commons 車 oracle bronze seal SVG historical character glyph
search_audit.outcome: Search corroborated candidate file pages and script labels. Followed each page’s Original file link. Oracle and seal SVGs were rejected by the web viewer as unsupported image content; bronze direct fetch returned a cache miss. The original file URLs themselves were obtained from those real links.

gaps: The direct SVG endpoints could not be rendered or pixel-inspected by the web tool. Their identity and rights are supported by the corresponding Commons descriptions; the acquisition harness should confirm downloadability.
The previously supplied image paths had incorrect hash directories. The verified page links provide the corrected paths, which are used below.

items.tradition: Chinese oracle-bone script; modern vector redraw based on cited Hanziyuan and Academia Sinica character images
items.caption: A modern redraw of 車 in Shang oracle-bone style. Early variants could spell out several parts of a vehicle; this drawing is an example of the script style, not a photograph of an oracle bone.
items.alt: Black vector drawing of an oracle-bone style form of 車 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: Offers an early graphic example relevant to the pictographic vehicle analysis; the page gives specific source-image references and CC0/public-domain terms.
items.rights: CC0 / public-domain dedication stated on the Commons page.

items.tradition: Chinese bronze-inscription script; modern vector redraw keyed to the cited 同卣 inscription image
items.caption: A modern redraw of 車 in Western Zhou bronze-script style. The Commons description links this form to an image of the character on the mid-Western Zhou vessel 同卣.
items.alt: Black vector drawing of a Western Zhou bronze-script form of 車 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: Adds a sourced intermediate form between oracle-bone and seal styles and identifies a particular mid-Western Zhou inscription image.
items.rights: CC0 / public-domain dedication stated on the Commons page.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition; transmitted dictionary form, compiled c. 100 CE
items.tradition: Chinese seal script; modern vector redraw referencing Hanziyuan and Academia Sinica
items.caption: A modern redraw of the 車 form associated with the Shuowen seal-script tradition, showing a more regularized shape than the cited oracle-bone and bronze examples.
items.alt: Black vector drawing of 車 in seal-script style on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: Shows a later, regularized script style to accompany the older inscription-based forms; the page names its source image and reusable rights.
items.rights: Public-domain dedication stated on the Commons page.

limitations.text: The image candidates are modern vector redrawings rather than photos of ancient artifacts. The captions describe their cited script styles and provenance, not visual observations made in this research pass.

Direct SVG rendering failed in the web tool, though exact original-file URLs were obtained by following each Commons page’s Original file link. Download success remains to be checked by the acquisition harness.
